title: onboard_ok
description: The onboarding was confirmed; the connection is authenticated as the new device (like pair_ok). For a watch (platform watchos or wearos, opened by its phone with the watch's key) the hub does not authenticate the connection: it sends onboard_ok and closes with 1000, so the phone never reads the watch's client_config; the watch's HA access follows sealed to the same key in watch_access. The client secret is never sent in clear: sealed is an HPKE base-mode message (RFC 9180, DHKEM(X25519, HKDF-SHA256), HKDF-SHA256, ChaCha20Poly1305; info = "hub/onboard/v1", aad = session_id as ASCII) to the session's public key. Plaintext: JSON {"client_id", "secret"}; the device checks that client_id equals the outer client_id. Known-answer vectors: fixtures/crypto/onboard-seal-vectors. Carries the protocol fields like pair_ok.

enc.description: HPKE encapsulated key (32 bytes), base64url without padding.

ciphertext.description: AEAD ciphertext incl. 16-byte tag, base64url without padding.
